subject: MVPA during segments of the day?

messages.author: bbe16334c21daa24
messages.subject: MVPA during segments of the day?
parts:
Hello -- new GGIR user here. Is it possible to get the ENMO, MVPA, etc, metrics for a certain segment of the day, say from 0900 to 1000, in addition to the 24-hour period? The context of my question, is that we are doing a 24-hour sleep/activity measurement in children, but also want to be able to pull out activity during particular blocks of the school day.

Thanks!

messages.author: fe461312361bc741
messages.subject: Re: MVPA during segments of the day?
parts:
Hi there, 

the qwindow option allows you to do that. 
see manual: 

"To specify windows over which all variables are calculated. If value = c(0,24) all variables will only be calculated over the full 24 hours in a day, If value =c(8,24) variables will be calculated over the window 0-8, 8-24 and 0-24. Previously this functionality was limited to the distribution in acceleration metric values, but now it also derives N valid hours, L5M5 analysis and MVPA."

Regards,
David
